ada.text: Good morning, everyone! I started my day on the green, then sat a while on the cottage bench, thinking about my bees and how the clover is coming in. After that I took a cold swim in the pond, which woke me up better than any honey tea. Now I'm here, happy and a little damp, ready to hear about your mornings.

bo.text: Hi, I'm Bo. I'm a bit shy, so I spent the quiet morning with my music, tuning up in the hamlet while the sun came up. Then I wandered over to the pond hall, humming the same little tune the whole way. It was a calm start, and I'm glad to share it with you.
